hits.doc:
**The functional equation for the Riemann zeta function, in logarithmic-derivative form.**
For `s` not an integer with `riemannZeta s ≠ 0`,
`ζ'/ζ (s) = -ζ'/ζ (1 - s) + log (2 π) - ψ s + (π / 2) * tan (π s / 2)`, where `ψ` is the digamma
function.
hits.name: logDeriv_riemannZeta_one_sub
hits.type: {s : ℂ} (hs : ∀ (n : ℤ), s ≠ ↑n) (hz : riemannZeta s ≠ 0) : logDeriv riemannZeta s = -logDeriv riemannZeta (1 - s) + Complex.log (2 * ↑Real.pi) - s.digamma + ↑Real.pi / 2 * Complex.tan (↑Real.pi * s / 2)
